notes: Site: IKEA DE (ikea.com/de/de), sibling of IKEA UK (SR92, same global platform). Tier 1 HTTP fetch of homepage showed only client-rendered mega-menu nav JSON (no product grid), so escalated to tier 2 Playwright, same as UK. Homepage nav JSON has a 'Neuheiten' (New) group with subItems 'Neue Produkte' (New Products) -> https://www.ikea.com/de/de/new/new-products/ (same URL shape/path as UK's /gb/en/new/new-products/) and 'Kollektionen' (Collections) -> https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/kollektion-collections/. Both opened and individually tested per the Sec.3 'Collection pages need inspection every time' rule. https://www.ikea.com/de/de/new/new-products/ opened with Playwright: h1/page title 'Neu bei IKEA' / 'Neue Produkte', on-page copy 'Du suchst nach neuen Produkten im IKEA Sortiment? Entdecke hier unsere neuen erschwinglichen Moebel und Wohnaccessoires.' (translation: looking for new products in the IKEA range? Discover our new affordable furniture and home accessories here) - a genuine 'recently added to catalogue' merchandising concept with a real browsable/filterable/sortable product grid (color, material, type, category, price filters), matching the UK sibling's classification exactly. Page text shows '1739 Produkte' twice (page header + filter-panel header) - cross-checked, qty verified reliable. This figure is legitimately much larger than the UK's 1139 (per the prior Home-Decor pass's own finding that DE and UK have fully independent per-country catalogs on the same global platform - every qty differs country to country, not copied). https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/kollektion-collections/ was checked and EXCLUDED: h1 'Kollektionen', meta description 'Dir faellt der Name der gesuchten IKEA Kollektion nicht ein? Kein Problem. Hier findest du alle Kollektionen auf einen Blick.' (translation: can't remember the name of the IKEA collection you're looking for? No problem - find all collections here at a glance) - this is a directory/index hub of named product-series collections (e.g. IKEA PS 2026, STOCKHOLM), not itself a listing of newly-added products; it does not represent 'recently added to catalogue' and has no product-count/PLP shape of its own, so it was excluded rather than flagged ambiguous (the page is unambiguously an editorial index of collection names, no product grid). Checked homepage nav (all mega-menu groups), footer, and searched for 'Neu eingetroffen'/'Neuankommlinge'/'Neu im Sortiment' equivalents - none found as distinct entry points beyond Neue Produkte. Individual product tiles across the site (e.g. IKEA PS 2026 items) carry their own 'New'/season badges but per Sec.3 that does not make those PDPs New Arrivals PLPs. Did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).
